latest_release.name: socket.io@4.8.4
latest_release.body:
### Bug Fixes

* cleanup pending acks on timeout to prevent memory leak ([37aad11](https://github.com/socketio/socket.io/commit/37aad11417d1020cf51d27a0cf90fa367efd5dc1))
* prevent uWebSockets.js from serving missing client files ([dfb5ab3](https://github.com/socketio/socket.io/commit/dfb5ab3b6a2f00d1ecb226939022ea56e5701124))
* reject stateful regexps for dynamic namespaces ([59f4f24](https://github.com/socketio/socket.io/commit/59f4f2413b2cd1d6a1cf91d367bac71af51f4a24))
* **types:** allow emitWithAck() for events with void callbacks ([#5453](https://github.com/socketio/socket.io/issues/5453)) ([8b93a18](https://github.com/socketio/socket.io/commit/8b93a1868146cf42391d21b254e6ff036372a608))
* **types:** properly import http module ([74599a6](https://github.com/socketio/socket.io/commit/74599a6b9e3dbeff1a9efe46c305d5d25d6e3dd8))


### Dependencies

- [`engine.io@~6.6.0`](https://github.com/socketio/engine.io/releases/tag/6.6.0) (no change)
- [`ws@~8.21.0`](https://github.com/websockets/ws/releases/tag/8.21.0) ([diff](https://github.com/websockets/ws/compare/8.18.3...8.21.0))
